speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Left Lower Lobe). The clinical presentation of pleuritic chest pain, productive cough with purulent sputum, and left-sided alveolar infiltrates with air bronchograms on X-ray, combined with a leukocytosis showing neutrophilic predominance, strongly supports this diagnosis.
